commands.room: Shows who owns the voice room you are in.
commands.name: Renames your voice room.
commands.limit: Sets how many people fit in your voice room. 0 means no limit.
commands.lock: Keeps new people out of your voice room.
commands.transfer: Hands your voice room to someone inside it.
